text.p: Dutch insurer Aegon NV said on Friday it expected the increase in eranings and earnings per share in guilders for 1996 to be in line with the nine month figures.
Earlier, the insurer reported a net profit rise for the first nine months of 1996 of 16.6 percent to 1.10 billion guilders and an increase in earnings per share of 15.6 percent to 4.15 guilders.
In August Aegon said the increase in earnings and earnings per share for the whole of 1996 would be in line with the rise in the first six months, respectively 15.7 and 15 percent.

"Based upon today's exchange rates and barring unforeseen exceptional circumstances, we expect the increase in earnings and earnings per share in guilders for 1996 to be in line with the nine month figures," Aegon said.
Commenting on the results, Aegon chairman Kees Storm said he was particularly pleased life insurance and pension premium income showed a healthy growth.

"Apart from the satisfactory growth of results, I am particilarly pleased life insurance and pension premium income showed a healthy growth in all group units, this improving our market position," Storm said.
